csv_scope_of_work: The City of Crestwood, Missouri (herein after City or Owner ) invites qualified firms to submit their qualifications for on-all architectural design and construction management services. To work with the City s leadership as an essential member of a project development team. The services provided will include, but are not limited to, the following: 1. Site review. 2. Feasibility studies and conceptual work. 3. Conceptual estimates for budgeting purposes. 4. Finalized design drawings. 5. Full project manual and specifications 6. Gathering any/all necessary federal, state, and local permitting and approvals for projects. 7. Attend pre-bid meetings. 8. Assist City with bid management and provide construction management services
